statement: Pinned SDL2 HIDAPI combines left and right Joy-Con devices into an in-process virtual 057e:2008 device by default when its combine hint permits, using L/R PID or grip name-side matching. This is not physical hardware enumeration.

applicability.revision: SDL2 release-2.30.12 at 8236e01; SDL3 at 535d80b; Linux v5.16 df0cc57 and later 4056b3c; joycond 0df025a; HHD 4184f03; all source-only
applicability.scope: SDL2 release 2.30.12 source-only pairing behavior; no actual SDL runtime tested.
